body.message:
As mentioned, the early check-in is completely subject to the Upside Living team, as they are responsible for preparing the apartment. Unfortunately, we cannot confirm or guarantee an early check-in from our side.

We can only submit your request for an early check-in. On the day of your arrival, you may check with the reception team, and they will advise you whether an early check-in is possible.

To clarify, if the apartment preparation were handled directly by our team, we would be able to provide a more definite confirmation. However, since it is managed by the Upside Living team, we can only request it on your behalf.

We hope you understand the situation and appreciate your kind understanding.
